high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "madovermarketing_mom." The post features a digital illustration of a meeting room with a large conference table at the center. The room has wooden walls and large windows that offer a view of a scenic landscape with mountains and trees. The text on the post reads: "Team members who don’t own an Oculus headset, can join the VR world through video call which will appear on a screen at the front of the workroom." In the illustration, there are six animated characters seated around the conference table.
